reading.title: The Impact of Artificial Intelligence on Education
reading.passage: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing education by personalizing learning experiences for students. AI-powered systems can adapt to individual learning styles, identify knowledge gaps, and provide targeted feedback in real-time. Teachers can use AI tools to automate grading and administrative tasks, allowing them to focus more on student engagement. However, concerns about data privacy and the potential reduction of human interaction in classrooms remain significant challenges that educators must address carefully.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one benefit of AI in education?
options: A) It eliminates the need for teachers
B) It can personalize learning experiences
C) It reduces the cost of textbooks
D) It prevents students from making mistakes
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'AI-powered systems can adapt to individual learning styles'라고 명시하고 있으므로, AI가 학습 경험을 개인화할 수 있다는 것이 정답입니다.

questions.q: What concern is mentioned regarding AI in education?
options: A) Students will become lazy
B) Technology costs too much
C) Data privacy concerns
D) AI cannot teach complex subjects
questions.explanation: 본문 마지막 문장에서 'concerns about data privacy and the potential reduction of human interaction'이 언급되어 있습니다.

questions.q: How can teachers benefit from using AI tools?
options: A) They can work fewer hours
B) They can automate grading and focus on engagement
C) They no longer need qualifications
D) They can ignore student feedback
questions.explanation: 'Teachers can use AI tools to automate grading and administrative tasks, allowing them to focus more on student engagement'에서 명확히 설명되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement that artificial intelligence will have a more positive impact than negative impact on society in the next ten years?

structure.intro: 당신의 입장을 명확히 제시하세요. 예: '나는 AI가 사회에 긍정적 영향을 미칠 것이라고 생각한다'는 식의 thesis statement를 작성합니다.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주장: AI가 의료, 교육, 생산성 향상 분야에서 긍정적 기여를 할 수 있다는 점을 구체적 예시와 함께 설명하세요.
structure.body2: 두 번째 주장: AI가 취업 시장 변화와 프라이버시 문제 등의 부정적 측면이 있지만, 이러한 도전은 관리 가능하다는 점을 논증하세요.
structure.conclusion: 도입부의 thesis를 재강조하면서, AI의 미래에 대한 신뢰와 준비의 필요성으로 마무리하세요.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work in a traditional office environment. Others prefer to work remotely from home. Which do you prefer and why?
sample_points: 원격근무의 장점: 출퇴근 시간 절약, 더 편안한 환경에서 일할 수 있음, 가족과 더 많은 시간을 보낼 수 있음
전통적 사무실의 장점: 동료들과 직접 협업, 빠른 피드백과 소통, 직무 교육과 멘토링 기회 증가

listening.title: Professor's Lecture on Climate Change
listening.script: Professor: Today, I want to discuss the relationship between deforestation and climate change. As many of you know, forests play a crucial role in absorbing carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. When we cut down trees, we're not only removing these natural carbon sinks, but we're also releasing stored carbon back into the air. The Amazon rainforest, for instance, is often called the 'lungs of the Earth' because it produces about 20% of the world's oxygen. Recent studies show that deforestation in the Amazon has accelerated significantly over the past decade. This has led to increased greenhouse gas emissions and has contributed substantially to global warming. Furthermore, the loss of forest ecosystems disrupts wildlife habitats and reduces biodiversity. Many scientists believe that if we don't act now to preserve these forests, we'll reach a critical tipping point where the damage becomes irreversible. Education and policy changes are essential to address this pressing issue.

questions.q: What is the main topic of the professor's lecture?
options: A) The benefits of deforestation
B) The relationship between deforestation and climate change
C) How to plant more trees
D) The economic value of the Amazon
questions.explanation: 교수가 'I want to discuss the relationship between deforestation and climate change'라고 명시적으로 강의의 주제를 제시했습니다.

questions.q: Why does the professor call the Amazon rainforest the 'lungs of the Earth'?
options: A) It is the largest forest
B) It produces about 20% of the world's oxygen
C) It is home to many animals
D) It has the oldest trees
questions.explanation: 교수의 설명 중 'The Amazon rainforest...is often called the lungs of the Earth because it produces about 20% of the world's oxygen'라는 부분에서 명확히 언급되었습니다.

questions.q: What does the professor suggest is necessary to address deforestation?
options: A) More technology and machinery
B) International trade agreements
C) Education and policy changes
D) Relocation of indigenous peoples
questions.explanation: 강의 마지막 부분에서 'Education and policy changes are essential to address this pressing issue'라고 명확히 제시되어 있습니다.
